_comment: n26l2 scan No0006, Ef/Hh/Ir at 64 Ms/s and Da/Cm at 128 Ms/s (decimated by ISBI). Uses JIVE's n26l2.vax, which -- unlike the n26l2.vex schedule -- has $THREADS, $CLOCK and $ANTENNA, so no channel-mapping or clock overrides are needed; Ir's swapped polarisations come out of $IF automatically. Verified against SFXC's fringe page for this scan (services.jive.eu/ftp_fringes/N26L2/scan06). Cm did not take part in the observation, so its file holds no sky signal; Ir had its polarisations swapped at the station, which the vax corrects in its $IF. The data files hold 2 s, hence start-time/runtime.
